description: Sends an existing draft exactly as it is stored, immediately and irreversibly; the draft disappears from the drafts list and becomes a sent message (returned id/threadId). Verify the content with get_draft before calling this. NEVER retried after a timeout or 5xx (a duplicate email cannot be unsent): if the outcome is unclear, check list_drafts (the draft is gone if it was sent) or list_messages in:sent before considering anything else. Daily sending limits apply (~500/day consumer, ~2000/day Workspace).

draft_id.description: The draft id from list_drafts or create_draft output.

name: send_draft
title: Send a draft
